concerns.text: T003 generates '100 synthetic hosts' with descriptors 'from real host descriptor statistics in data/raw/descriptors_added.csv', but plan T001b mandates the verified HuggingFace SMILES parquet (200 molecules, seed 42) as the simulation source. Worse, when the scrape legitimately yields zero records (the T001-repaired path), descriptors_added.csv is empty, making the simulation input undefined — the FR-011 branch cannot execute. This silently relaxes the plan's reproducible, canonical-source simulation (Constitution Principle I: 'External datasets MUST be fetched from the same canonical source on every run').

The plan's independent evaluation set (independent_eval.csv, feature-independent N(0,1) targets) and task T011 are entirely absent from tasks.md. The plan justifies this as breaking the simulation circularity (methodology-f4c7012e, scientific_soundness-f0482303) and lists it in Complexity Tracking as required. Dropping it without documentation is a silent plan-constraint relaxation that leaves simulated-mode performance claims circular.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior vs plan.md:T010 / Constitution Principle II
concerns.text: Plan T010 (Reference-Validator Agent citation verification, Constitution Principle II, 'CI blocks on failure') has no corresponding task; tasks.md's 'Revision behavior' removes platform-owned concerns but citation verification is a research-stage deliverable per the plan's Constitution Check table, not platform CI. Either add a task or explicitly document the handoff.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior vs Constitution Principle III
concerns.text: Constitution Principle III requires 'Datasets MUST be checksummed and the checksum recorded under data/'. tasks.md explicitly removes state.yaml hashing as platform-owned, but no task records dataset checksums under data/ — the constitutional requirement is neither tasked nor documented as delegated.
Retry policy contradicts: tasks.md T001 'max 3 retries', plan T001a 'max 5 retries'. FR-001 leaves the count unspecified; pick one and align both artifacts.
Bootstrap resample counts disagree: tasks.md T005 '≥50 resamples' vs plan T006 '1000 resamples'. FR-006 says only 'multiple'; align on one value for reproducibility of stability CVs.

T004 requires model_runs.json to conform to BOTH model_output.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml; the schemas have conflicting required shapes (nested metrics vs top-level r2_mean, additionalProperties:false) and data-model.md says model_runs.json is a list while model_output.schema.yaml defines a single object. As written the verification is unsatisfiable — specify which schema validates which artifact/file shape.
